title: Ship the First Frontend-to-API Vertical Slice
goal: Connect the web app to the API and use browser/network evidence to understand the complete HTTP exchange.
steps: Write the request and response contract before writing fetch code.
Call `GET /tasks` from the web application and inspect URL, method, headers, status, timing, and JSON.
Add `POST /tasks` and return 201 with the created resource.
Send malformed input and verify the chosen 4xx response.
Force a server failure and distinguish 5xx behavior from client errors.
Run frontend/API on different origins and configure the narrow CORS policy needed for development.
Compare cookie and bearer-token request shapes without treating either as authorization by itself.
Document the final API contract with examples.
evidence: A clean Git diff or file-tree change
Browser, HTTP, database, test, container, or CI evidence that proves the behavior
One deliberate failure, the evidence you used, and the root-cause fix
A short explanation of why the final responsibility lives in the chosen layer
completion: I can reproduce one key part without the walkthrough.
I can explain one trade-off I deliberately chose.
I can show one failure that my tests, constraints, or runbook now protects against.
